3. Match the player's exposed skin complexion to the selfie naturally under the existing scene lighting. Do not alter muscle mass, body proportions or anatomy.
Scene 3 exception: recolour ONLY the existing jerseys of its two distant teammates; do not alter any other part of them.

EVERYTHING ELSE MUST REMAIN AS IN IMAGE 1: EXACT same player coordinates, scale, torso, stride, limb angles, hands, football, position of every other person and object, background, crowd, stadium, goalposts, camera perspective, framing, lighting and shadows. NEVER change the player's body position or action. Do NOT rebuild, restage, replace, enhance, beautify or reinterpret the scene. If there is any conflict, preserve the master photograph's geometry and background while maintaining the selfie identity wherever visible. One vertical 9:16 edited photo.
